task.description:
Implement PRM-02, PRM-03, PRM-04, PRM-05 UI components (Stage 16 MUST, VALIDATED) per design artefacts.

BRANCH: feature/WF02-prm-batch2-20260814 (base: origin/main 05be8706)
DESIGN ARTEFACTS:
- src/design/prm-02-conflict-preflight-rejection.md
- src/design/prm-03-plan-digest.md
- src/design/prm-04-promotion-review-state-machine.md
- src/design/prm-05-non-skippable-approval-gate.md

EXISTING FRONTEND CODE:
- web/src/ (React/TypeScript UI components)
- web/src/api/ (API client)

IMPLEMENTATION TASKS:

PRM-02: Conflict pre-flight rejection UI
- Display ConflictRejection details when promotion returns HTTP 409 PROMOTION_CONFLICT
- Show conflicting definitions with source change vs target change
- Clear error state in promotion workflow UI

PRM-03: Plan digest UI
- Display plan_digest in promotion review UI
- Show digest verification status (matched/mismatched)
- Display the canonical JSON being digested (formatted, human-readable)

PRM-04: Promotion review state machine UI
- Display promotion_reviews status: pending_review / approved / rejected / applied / failed / superseded
- Show state machine edges visually (current state highlighted)
- Display approved_by, approved_at, superseded_by, row_version
- Show plan_digest and serialised plan

PRM-05: Non-skippable approval gate UI
- GET /api/v1/promotions/{id}/context → display NEEDS_REVIEW package, stored plan, plan_digest, artifact assertions
- Reject/Approve buttons: confirm requested_by != approved_by
- If self-approval attempt → show HTTP 403 error inline
- Apply button disabled unless plan_digest present in context
- Show HTTP 422 error if extra fields sent on apply

Return PASS when:
- TypeScript compiles cleanly (web/ tsc --noEmit)
- No new lint errors
- All new components have proper TypeScript types
- Git status shows all changes on feature branch
